$comment: Task routing for the brain (owner 2026-11-14: route each task to the model, effort, lane, executing role and validators that fit it; local LLM always at highest effort; when no route fits, find or build the agent). The machine-readable form of DR-047 rules 1-3 plus the four-pass pipeline (Bonsai intake, plan and first implementation -> local Claude/Codex review -> validation on the other local session -> cloud final; docs/LANE_COORDINATION.md 2026-11-13). scripts/lib/task-route.mjs resolves a task kind against this file; scripts/check-task-routing.mjs gates it: every role exists in docs/agent/org-roster.json, every skill and agent exists, every build/judgment kind names a validator, decision-path kinds stay owner-gated, and an unknown kind resolves to the capability-gap route in docs/agent/hand-routing.json, never to a default tier. Tier names are DR-047 families, never model ids. Private vault/runtime content never enters this file: it routes kinds of work, not the work itself.

local-llm.role: intake, scoped plan and first implementation (Bonsai)

local-claude.role: review the first artifact and record findings

local-codex.role: review the first artifact and record findings

local-validate.role: run the real checks and consume pass 2 findings
local-validate.rule: the validating lane is never the pass-2 lane

docs-restamp.when: Docs-only restamps, figure re-measures a gate already computes, ledger rows.

log-scan.when: Read-only scanning of logs, CI output or tables to map facts for a later decision.

gate-or-proof.when: A gate, proof or script under scripts/** with a falsifiable check.

ci-workflow.when: A .github/workflows edit or CI job change.

web-ui.when: Web app, PWA or accessibility work outside the decision path.

build-failure.when: A red build, typecheck or failing test that must be root-caused.

security-review.when: Anything handling input, auth, secrets, credentials or a trust boundary.

architecture.when: Design, module boundaries or a reversible technical decision record.

agent-or-skill.when: Creating or changing a .claude agent, skill or command; also where a capability gap lands once specified.

decision-core.when: lib/* decision core, /v1 contracts or anything that changes what SignalGrid decides; never auto-merged.

prioritization.when: Which work next, how items fit together, grooming the queue.

steps: Search the existing roster, skills and agents for a fit (docs/agent/org-roster.json, .claude/skills, .claude/agents).
Search the sibling repositories for a tool to absorb (pnpm run scan:estate; docs/agent/RESOURCE_INTAKE.md rules).
If none fits, raise a capability-gap hand: blocker-dispatcher writes the spec and agent-platform-steward builds and registers the agent or skill, then the kind is added here.
